verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible server, so prefix caching is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence mentions prefix caching or KV-cache reuse across repeated prompts. Its documented speedups (SSD expert offload, a pre-router that predicts expert loads one step ahead) are different performance features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can speed up repeated-prompt workloads using prefix caching
